message:
Fantasy: unlock starter farming and add per-second spiritual cultivation

Allow direct travel to eligible maps and open Dong Co Gio at the first realm, with beginner encounters tuned for new characters.

Replace path mastery with real-time spiritual power, realm base absorption, additive research/book bonuses and explicit breakthroughs. Subtract only the required threshold and carry all surplus into the next stage; preserve legacy save progress.

Cover real-time UI behavior, pause/hidden tabs, overflow, book stacking, migration and thirty complete novice farming trips. Preserve Vietnam and World gameplay.

Fantasy: simplify interface, unlock free hunting and expand maps, academy and events

Group the interface into six sections with character/family details behind one control and move the journal up. Fix settlement travel at Linh Tuyen and align map buttons with travel rules; add regional NPC services, crafting, enhancement and equipment.

Separate hunting from annual learning actions, extend skills to level 10, replace the level-40 display/cap with path mastery and add five academy courses with permanent mind/passive progression. Add 36 authored situations, 40 regional variants and varied infant scenes with source research notes.

Validate Fantasy lifecycle, combat, services, academy, UI/save isolation and real-world/family isolation. Real-world gameplay files are unchanged.
8.3.0: add contextual family, parenting and relationship interactions

v8.2.0: fix Fantasy play loop, readable UI and class-specific progression

Use the main Vietnamese font system and mark Fantasy experimental. Add persistent war news, visible EXP, timed progression with pause/speed controls and reading-aware log scroll retention. Restrict combat training and skills to the chosen path while sharing forging/alchemy; implement five skill ranks with real damage scaling and truthful descriptions. Reject stale choice clicks and avoid repeated imported topics. Preserve legacy skills and normal-mode snapshots; include tests and Cloudflare dist.zip.

v8.1.0: expand Fantasy clan politics with causal wars and contextual events

Adapt five pinned Aurelia Hugging Face sources into compact simulation profiles. Add regional resources, pairwise relations, succession, multi-year border wars, armies and supply, treaties, ceasefires, relief, front orders and market prices. Gate player decisions by age, title, ownership and actual resources; expire stale scenes and isolate all real-world modes. Include attribution, reproducible data tools, regression coverage and Cloudflare dist.zip.

v8.0.0: add independent Fantasy clan RPG and restore child agency in Hardcore

Integrate five attributed Hugging Face datasets with Vietnamese adaptations, lifecycle, training, combat, guilds, quests, territories and succession. Keep ordinary modes and saves isolated. Include reproducible data tooling, regression coverage and Cloudflare dist.zip.

Release 7.7.1: contextual Hardcore stories and dedicated sports training

Match Hardcore situations and choices to actual household resources, remove repetitive explanatory text, and update old pending scenes without rerolling fees or RNG. Add bounded sports talent practice and professional esports training for reflexes, tactics and form, preserving progress through saves and annual updates.

Include contextual and training regression checks and the updated Cloudflare dist.zip build.

Release 7.7.0: dedicated Hardcore campaign and preserve heir family data

Add age-specific Hardcore choices, lasting family pressure and emotional recovery, difficult earnings and rare career breakthroughs. Preserve Vietnamese sibling identities across settled-family generations, handle empty sibling rosters and legacy housing snapshots. Include regression coverage, normal-mode isolation checks and the Cloudflare dist.zip build.

Một Đời v5.6.1 — rà soát lỗi logic

- Điểm thi THPT sát thực tế: trung bình ~23–24, học siêu giỏi vẫn đạt 30, học rất kém có thể trượt tốt nghiệp và thi lại / học nghề / đi làm; cờ học bổng khớp điểm (cả tuyển thẳng, thi lại)
- Sửa "THPT chuyên tại undefined", crash chiêu mộ esports, gợi ý trống ở di chúc
- Tên nhân vật không còn lệch dấu (ế, ồ…): phông dự phòng hỗ trợ đủ tiếng Việt thay cho Georgia
- Pháp Kiều gọi thẳng tên; gọi đúng người yêu / vợ / chồng / người bạn đời trong lựa chọn và mục "Việc bạn muốn làm"
- Giá món ăn, địa danh địa phương theo từng loại; đi lại trong tỉnh vài chục nghìn
